text: During the reign of King Mongkut, Mak [returns from war to his village of Phra Khanong|trigger|going back home] with four soldier friends, glad to see his wife Nak, who [endured childbirth alone|wrong|abandonment and rejection] while he was away. Villagers flee at the sight of him, a cradle rocks on its own, and Nak's [arm stretches unnaturally beneath the house|rules|it has unnatural powers] to fetch a lime. When the friends find a decomposed corpse wearing Nak's ring, they argue over [which of the couple is the ghost|threat|the restless dead].
